description.en: Pins a small always-on-top box to the Windows desktop: live status for every conversation, inline answers for pending approvals and questions, and one click to bring the main window back.
description.zh: 在 Windows 桌面置顶一个小方框：实时看各对话在跑什么、几个在等确认，需要授权或选择时直接在小窗里点选，点一下把主窗口唤回前台。
